fault_pattern: BPFI (148 Hz impact bursts), high-frequency envelope elevation, local thermal spike >65C
root_cause_analysis: Micro-spalling on inner raceway due to contaminated grease or excessive dynamic axial preload.
action_checklist: 1. Check grease condition and replenish with ISO VG 100 polyurea lubricant.
2. Monitor vibration RMS hourly; if RMS exceeds 7.1 mm/s (ISO 10816 Zone C), schedule planned replacement.
3. Verify laser coupling alignment to prevent excessive radial preloading.

fault_pattern: Phase current unbalance > 10%, winding temperature > 110C, 2X supply line frequency sidebands (120 Hz)
root_cause_analysis: Inter-turn insulation breakdown caused by thermal aging and repeated voltage spikes.
action_checklist: 1. Immediately throttle motor load to below 50% to prevent full phase-to-ground flashover.
2. Conduct insulation resistance test (Megger 1000V DC) and polarization index (PI) measurement.
3. If insulation resistance < 5 MOhm, execute emergency controlled shutdown for stator rewinding.

fault_pattern: High-frequency broadband acoustic emissions (10-50 kHz), erratic flow rate drop > 20%, suction pressure < NPSHr
root_cause_analysis: Net Positive Suction Head available (NPSHa) lower than required, causing vapor cavity implosions on impeller vane surfaces.
action_checklist: 1. Inspect suction strainer and inlet valve for partial clogging or debris accumulation.
2. Verify liquid level in supply tank and de-aerate suction piping.
3. Throttle discharge regulating valve to shift pump operating point back toward Best Efficiency Point (BEP).

fault_pattern: Pronounced 2X rotational frequency harmonic (59.6 Hz) accompanied by high axial vibration (>6.5 mm/s)
root_cause_analysis: Angular and parallel misalignment between driver and driven shafts, causing cyclical bending moment on flexible disc.
action_checklist: 1. Perform dial indicator or dual-laser coupling alignment check in cold and hot operating states.
2. Inspect elastomeric insert or metal disc pack for shear tearing or fretting corrosion.
3. Torque all foundation hold-down bolts to specified rating (180 Nm) to eliminate soft-foot condition.
